Executed five frozen CONTROL heads with verified original whole-image T=1 preprocessing. Validation exact-choice mean 19.00% ± 4.18 pp; 0/10 paired-both-correct in every seed. items.title: Expansion to similar financial concepts
items.verified_result: Audited seven concepts over 150 filings and built a balanced two-concept × two-period challenge. Final cohort is 192 Train / 80 Validation queries from 68 source pairs; ambiguous source tables excluded before fitting. Five-seed text-head v1 exact-choice 39.25% ± 0.68 pp. Same-cohort v2 source-context reserialization fits all 1,088 inputs within 145–173 tokens; exact-choice 37.25% ± 0.56 pp (−2.00 pp), concept-choice projection 70.50%, period-choice projection 51.50%. Both sets of checkpoints independently replayed. A separate Train-defined string-only parser on the same v2 inputs answers 72/80 Validation queries, all 72 correct; 8 unseen HD Net sales alias cases abstain. Strict independent issuer-from-evidence mode answers 0/80 because issuer headers are absent.
items.remaining_or_limit: Expansion and representation repair were executed, but v2 did not improve accuracy. These are new exploratory 80-target metrics, not original 115-target model accuracy or standalone taxonomy-head accuracy. V2 adds explicit source units/dates/signs, so it is not a pure truncation-only ablation. Historical development companies are reused; source-pair queries are correlated; no Test outcomes used. The parser result is conditional supplied-table recoverability, not neural uplift or independently entity-verified extraction. Generic date/type guards were added as disclosed post-evaluation QA without changing decisions.
